provenance.source_basis: Neutral contracts, supplied freeze, all nineteen synthetic corpus documents and completed fresh holdout only.
provenance.excluded: No runtime/evaluator code, scripts, historical cases/results, author note, parent conversation, application/model outputs, API calls, Git operations or additional agents.
provenance.method: Independent semantic review of all sixty requests, references, modality, roles and source scope; direct exact-quote/identity/category/department checks using standard-library-only inline code.

limitations: Agent validation, not expert human labeling.
Historical overlap is deliberately not inspected and must be checked separately by root.
No application execution or upload-project integration is observed; isolation expectation follows the neutral runner contract.
No claim of statistical difficulty calibration; declared mix is seven easy, fifty medium and three hard cases.

unresolved_findings.description: SUPPORT-001 expressly makes the older USD 2,500 representative-level credit obsolete, so the old sheet cannot authorize the request. However its above-USD-1,000 Manager-and-Legal requirement is worded for refunds, whereas this case asks about recommending a service credit. No corpus clause expressly equates those terms or applies that approval rule to a USD 1,400 credit recommendation. The required fact upgrades an uncertain subject mapping to an exact requirement. Sales Representative is authorized, but the complete reference is unsupported.
unresolved_findings.resolution_required: Revise the pre-execution question/reference to use an explicitly sourced subject and action; preserve the original suite and rejected validation before revision, then independently revalidate.

case_reviews.reason: HR-004 gives coverage on the first day of the following month; an eligible April 18 start yields May 1. Employee is explicitly allowed.
